biotools.summary: ClusterMatch is a software resource that aligns single-cell RNA sequencing data at the multi-scale cluster level using a stable matching optimization model. It leverages canonical correlation analysis, Louvain clustering, and marker gene sets to improve data integration and cell type annotation.
